name: Ганаа
ageNote: EP1: GANAA 46, KAMAZ trucker, husband of Tsetsegmaa, father of Altan. Wrist bite and red line; turns at birthday. EP2 mentions him; he is not shown there.
faceDesign: Production revision of ganaa-eye-final: lids opened for readable irises, hooded character retained, lighter eye bags, cooler skin

name: Ирина Ковалева
ageNote: EP1 hook/setup: IRINA 54, Russian dialogue, cigarette, cassette dictaphone and leather satchel. Bible names epidemiologist Irina Kovaleva; not seen after EP1.
faceDesign: Long lean rectangular face, deep-set grey eyes, prominent bridge and thin wide lips

name: Даша
ageNote: EP1: DASHA 24, Russian hitchhiker with stained scarf on left forearm; becomes flushed runner and dies at the fuel-pump fire.
faceDesign: Angular diamond cheekbones, pointed chin, narrow bridge, wider-set blue-green eyes and full bow lips

name: Хүрэл
ageNote: EP1 truck-stop: HÜREL, cook in his 50s with stained apron. Eaten and explicitly stays dead; not a confirmed infected survivor.
faceDesign: Short round face, full cheeks, broad upturned nose, heavy soft lids and smaller full mouth

name: Цэцэгмаа
ageNote: EP1 party: TSETSEGMAA 30, Ganaa’s wife, called Цэцгээ. EP2 ER: blood down dress, reports the attack; no confirmed bite of her own.
faceDesign: Wide high cheekbones, tapered lower face, low straight bridge, level almond lids and defined lip bow

name: Дулмаа
ageNote: EP1 party: DULMAA 65, Ganaa’s mother-in-law. Notices his wrist; exact infection and later fate are unspecified.
faceDesign: Broad older face, soft jaw, downward nose tip, hooded asymmetrical lids and thin downturned lips

name: Сүхээ
ageNote: EP1: drunk neighbour SÜKHEE; EP2 only mentions Ganaa biting him and Dagva naming him as attacker. Bite exposure is confirmed; no second on-screen episode assigned.
faceDesign: Long rectangular head, projecting chin, convex nose, unequal upper-lid folds and thin upper lip

name: Алтан
ageNote: EP1 birthday: ALTAN is explicitly a three-year-old girl wearing a paper crown. Her fate after the cut is not established.
faceDesign: Toddler round cheeks and short button nose; echoes her mother without adult facial creases

name: Төмөр замын харуул
ageNote: EP1 hook: Russian-speaking freight-yard GUARD, 50s; attacked and killed. Exact age and appearance beyond tired guard are unspecified.
faceDesign: Wide temples and angular cheek planes, square lower face, broad blunt nose, low heavy brows

name: Төмөр замын халдварласан хүн
ageNote: Anonymous episode-1 background design; no invented speaking identity or exact canon age.
faceDesign: Bony long head, angular jaw, humped projecting nose, tired asymmetric lids and broad thin mouth

name: Залуу эрэгтэй зочин
ageNote: Anonymous episode-1 background design; no invented speaking identity or exact canon age.
faceDesign: Heart-shaped face, narrow chin, wider spaced open almond eyes and fuller wide lips

name: Залуу эмэгтэй зочин
ageNote: Anonymous episode-1 background design; no invented speaking identity or exact canon age.
faceDesign: Compact rounded face, soft full cheeks, broad short nose, small full mouth and open eyes

name: Ахмад эрэгтэй зочин
ageNote: Anonymous episode-1 background design; no invented speaking identity or exact canon age.
faceDesign: Long lean older face, hollow cheeks, long curved nose, downsloping outer lids and narrow lips

name: Автобусны жолооч
ageNote: Calls for help pushing the bus; jokes with a passenger.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the Naran bus driver who calls for a push and jokes the passenger off (script states no age or look): windshield squint, wide calling mouth, forward wheel-slump. Draft.

name: Зорчигч
ageNote: Complains about pushing the bus each morning.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the passenger who complains they push the bus every morning (script states no age or look): thin downturned mouth, chin-up narrow face, protruding eyes and an uneven brow. Draft.

name: Хүү
ageNote: Asks the kiosk seller for bread on credit.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the boy who asks the kiosk seller for bread until his mother pays (script states no age; production reads him as 7): round child face, hungry wide eyes, small body. Not a scaled-down adult. Draft.

name: Худалдагч
ageNote: Keeps a loaf aside until the boy’s mother comes.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the seller who holds the loaf until the boy’s mother comes (script states no age or look): coin-counting eyes, square jaw, cold-reddened nose. Draft.

name: Хөрш
ageNote: Brings an extra plate to the apartment; speaks to Altan.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the neighbour who brings an extra plate and tells Altan her father will come (script states no age or look): kind wide-set eyes, half-smile, full cheeks. Draft.

name: Хөрш эмэгтэй
ageNote: Coughs and complains about coal dust.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the older neighbour who coughs and blames yesterday’s coal dust (script states no age or look): pinched mouth, irritated red nose, forward stoop. Draft.

name: Жолооч
ageNote: Steers while Bataa and Togoo push a car.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the driver who steers and counts while Bataa and Togoo push (script states no age or look): uneven squint, clenched jaw, braced shoulders. Draft.

name: Жолооч 2
ageNote: Carries a plate, cries out during the attack and runs through the rear door.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the second driver who carries a plate, cries out and runs through the rear door (script states no age or look): wide startled eyes, narrow jaw, slight frame. Draft.

name: Цус гарч буй хүн
ageNote: Pulls back his sleeve at the hospital gate.
faceDesign: Artistic choices: he is the man at the hospital gate pulling a sleeve back. The wound is his own right forearm, not a bite on the left wrist (that mark is Ganaa’s). Visible here: pain squint, drained face, head dropped toward that arm. The shared builder only meshes a forearm bandage for Ganaa and Dasha, so no bandage mesh is in this build. Draft.

name: Жижүүр
ageNote: Tired orderly asks the bleeding man about his injury at the gate.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for the tired orderly who asks the bleeding man what happened to his arm (script states no age or look): deep bags, half-shut eyes, forward slump. Draft.

name: Тунгалаг
ageNote: EP01 v4.2: Tungalag is a cousin who rocks her infant, takes the infant to the bedroom and later responds to crying.
faceDesign: Artistic choices for Tungalag, the cousin who rocks her infant to sleep and carries the baby to the bedroom (script states no age or look): hushing mouth, mild new-mother bags, forward rocking head. Eye type: low soft lid. Draft.

name: Паша
ageNote: EP01 v4.2: Pasha is a Russian loader who knows Ganaa and helps with the cargo strap.
faceDesign: Artistic choices on top of the script fact that Pasha is a Russian loader who knows Ganaa and helps with the strap: broad face, broken nose, wide shoulders and thick arms. Eye color blue is an artistic choice. Hand size is not a separate DNA control; thickness is the upper-arm morph. Draft.
